setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A curious octopus repeatedly enters a fisher's traps and escapes.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The scientist learns how it solves simple puzzles but questions confinement.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The octopus stops eating, and the scientist releases it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The animal slips into the reef, leaving the fisher fascinated.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: It returns to the traps the following week.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The octopus escapes unharmed while fishers still catch their supper.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The new traps fail at first, costing the village a day's catch.
